02-welcome-pack.verdict: The e4 centred card is a real step toward the guide, but it still has an explaining paragraph, rarity-coloured names, a heavy 'Take the pack' button and a bare close button with no X; the e1 full-screen slab is the exact pattern the guide deletes.

03-hub-floor.verdict: The pixel art hub reads as a place, but it has no clear focal point, the HUD is tiny and unaligned with the style guide, and the screen is crowded with identical NPC sprites, overlapping glow circles and a stray text line.
findings: P0 top-right career HUD ($900, 0 xp, stash $3,750 bag $0): Build the cw-trcol column: one item per line, all at --fs-body 20px f-cond 600, label in --tx-2 and value in --tx-1, 24px from the edge. '$900' is the only item at 800 weight. Put it on a --ui-panel at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --rad 4px.

P0 station labels ('the stash', 'the last pour', 'fashion'): Delete the sentence, or turn it into a 16px '--warn' tag 'experimental' placed beside the title. Remove the asterisks. Move sprites out from under label boxes or draw labels above the sprite layer with a --scrim plate.

P1 whole hub floor, 12 identical pillager sprites: Cut the idle sprites to about 4 and spread them out. Ring the player sprite with the --acc lime. Make 'enter raid' the only label with an --acc fill or underline, at 32px against 20px for the other labels.

P1 station glow circles: Shrink the glow to the 3px ring that already exists. Remove the stray grey disc at centre and the overlapping circle at the mainframe. Reserve lime for the focused or nearest station and use 20% line colour for the others.

P1 station labels, type consistency: Set labels to --fs-title 32px with 8px/16px padding, a --ui-panel plate and a 1px --ui-line-hi border at 4px radius, or drop the plate and use a shadowed text label. Use --fs-body for secondary stations.

04-stash-terminal.verdict: The stash is a functional, consistent dark card, but it is overcrowded and flat. Almost every label is the same small size, the key map and legend compete with the item grid, and the lime 'take' button is the only thing the eye lands on.
findings: P0 right pane, gun keys / item wheel block (y 640-890): Collapse gun keys and item wheel into one tabbed or toggled sub-panel. Alternatively give each a 24px gap and a 16px label. Raise the key digits to 16px in a 24px chip with 8px inset. Replace the 'wheel' placeholder with a proper header cell.

P1 whole card, hierarchy: Make '$900' the one hero number at 32px/800 with 24px spacing from the other stats. Drop section labels to 16px tx-2 and keep tab text at 20px. Move 'xp' and 'stash 3,750 bag 0' into a muted 16px group.
P1 header stats and top tab row: Move armory and trophies to the header-right as 40px-high bordered buttons. Keep the tab row for filters only. Set every gap in this row to 16 or 24px.

P1 stash grid (left pane): Draw empty slots as faint 1px dashed cells to fill the grid, as the backpack does, or use a larger tile with the item name below at 16px. Move the right pane's loadout/backpack split to match the grid's cell size.

P1 bottom 'freebie kit' bar and legend row: Give 'take' a 48px-high rect with 4px radius and no top tab. Show the kit contents as small icons in the bar. Cut the legend to the 3 needed hints, or show it only on hover.

05-sector-page.verdict: The ascend button is a strong primary action, and the card, X and lime focus follow the guide. The screen still crams a map, a conditions column and a kit and pack column into one card, with truncated names, tiny type and a competing lime price highlight.
findings: P1 right column: pack rows (medkit to compact s...): Widen the name column to at least 160px or drop the /n cap into a 16px tx-2 sub-line. Give the price column a fixed 88px width and draw it in tx-1 for affordable items, with --danger only on rows the player can't afford. Show every name in full, with no ellipsis.
P1 right column: the $660 price on the bandage row: Make the focused buy slot a 2px --acc border on a --ui-raised fill with tx-1 text, never a lime-tinted fill. Also hide focus on idle rows.

P1 whole card: hierarchy and density: Add 1px --ui-line dividers and 24px gaps between the kit, pack and loadout sub-sections. Raise the section labels to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2. Shrink the map by about 15% and give the freed width to the right column.

P1 map: room labels and exit markers: Draw room labels at 16px f-cond 600 in tx-1 with no pill, and put a 1px --ui-void halo under the text. Move labels clear of the boxes. Draw the exit text at 16px. Tint the map fill with --ui-raised instead of blue. Add a one-word legend or remove the purple squares.
P2 footer legend and ascend button: Set the legend at 16px in tx-2 and align it to the 24px padding. Make the keycap text 16px with 8px padding. Make it clear the hint is for the live device.

06-terms.verdict: The terms card now has a readable hierarchy, with bright row names, a bold bonus number and a larger 'sign nothing' button. It is still a flat grey list with no accent, no focus state and a lot of dead space, so it looks like a table and not a game menu.
findings: P1 whole card, no focus or selection: Fill the focused row with --ui-raised and add a 3px --acc left bar. Make the focused sign button an --acc fill with --acc-ink text. Keep the idle buttons outlined in --ui-line-hi.

P1 layout, top and bottom of the card: Put the title in the 56px header row at the top left, aligned with the list's left edge at x=261, and on the same line as the X. Make rows 88px tall with 24px padding so the list fills the card, and anchor the footer row at the bottom.

P1 bonus numbers (+25%, +30%): Set the bonus to the 32px title size in --tx-1, or in --acc as the hero number, and keep the title at 32px but quieter. Add a small 'pay' label (16px, tx-2) above or after each number. Pick one bold element per screen.
P2 row descriptions: Raise descriptions to 16px at --tx-2 with at least 4.5:1 contrast. Shorten the strings, for example 'raid clock -33%'.

P2 footer status line and divider: Drop the sentence or turn it into a 16px status chip ('signed: none'). Put the status and 'sign nothing' in one 72px footer row, with the button right-aligned or as the lime default action. Use 24px spacing between the list and the footer.

07-party-coop.verdict: The copy is shorter and the type is bigger, but the screen is still a small column of text floating in a nearly empty 90 percent card, with no clear main action and no focus state.
findings: P0 whole card, content block at y 380-690: Lay out two columns inside the card. Put a 48px-padded header row at the top with the title left-aligned at 32px and the x on the right. Below it, put a 4-slot party roster on the left and the host and join actions on the right. Alternatively shrink the card to about 60 percent width for this small window.

P0 host a party and join a party buttons, y 575-690: Make host a party a lime --acc fill with --acc-ink text, 48px high and at least 200px wide, with 20px f-cond 700 text. Keep join a party as a quiet outlined button. Draw a visible focus bar on the pad-selected button.

P1 lime status line 'not in a party...' (y 490): Set it in tx-2 at 20px, or replace it with a short status such as 'no party', paired with a small ok or warn glyph. Reserve lime for the host a party button.

P1 join field (564,575 to 1489,643) and join a party button: Put host a party on its own row. Put the join field and join a party button on a second row, with the field 48px high and the button at its right, both with identical heights and top edges. Use 16px gaps between rows.

P1 intro, hint and trade lines (y 453-598): Cut the trade line and the pty1o hint. Reduce the field to a short label 'invite code' at 16px. Keep one line, 'up to four pillagers', at 20px tx-2. Use a consistent 24px gap between blocks.

08-shop.verdict: The shop is a clean, consistent dark card with one lime action and a clear focus tile, but half the grid area is empty, the detail pane has a big dead gap, and the header and footer details are sloppy.
findings: P1 item grid, rows 3 and up (y 590-1000): Make tiles bigger (about 220x210 with a 72px icon) so 9 items fill about 70% of the height. Or shrink the panel to fit its content. Add category filters in the left column only if they are needed.
P1 detail pane, y 480-770: Add a large item icon (about 160px) under the title and move the price block up. Or put the stats in a 2-column block at 20px and anchor the price block 24px below it.

P1 header, top right (900 credits, 0 xp, stash 3,750 bag 0): Show money as '$900' in the same style as the price. Make stash and bag two matching label-over-value pairs with 32px gaps. Drop xp from the shop if it does nothing here. Leave 24px before the X.
P1 bottom toast 'everything here works. cannot say the same for you.': Delete the line. If a hint line must stay, use 14px f-body tx-2 in the footer row, left-aligned inside the card, with no box.
P2 item tiles, price tags: Set all prices to 16px f-cond 600 tx-1. Use --danger for prices the player cannot afford and drop the lime from prices. Keep lime for the focus border only.

09-craft.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear focus tile and a visible close x, but half the card is empty, the header money readouts are cluttered and contradictory, and the hold-to-craft button and the footer tip are weak.
findings: P1 item grid / left panel: Make tiles fill the panel (for example 4 columns of about 260x200 tiles, or 6 columns with 240px tall tiles), or shrink the panel to fit its content and use the freed height for a larger detail pane with a 96px item preview.

P1 header top-right currency strip: Keep one money readout, '$900', at 20px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Drop the duplicate 'you hold' line. Show stash and bag as 16px tx-2 labels. Leave 24px between the strip and the x. Remove xp from this window.

P1 hold to craft button: When it cannot be done, show a --ui-line-hi 1px outline with tx-2 text at 4.5:1 or better, and add a 16px --danger 'need 3 scrap metal'. When it can be done, use a --acc fill with --acc-ink text, 56px tall, at the 20px size.
P1 bottom tooltip 'half the pillager bots down here walk past scrap. their loss.': Delete it. If a hint is kept, put it in the footer at 14px tx-2, 24px from the card edge, with no box.
P2 tab row and 'you hold' line: Set tabs at 20px f-cond 600 with a 3px --acc underline on the active one, and a 48px row height. Remove the 'you hold' row, which also gives the grid back about 30px.

10-hire.verdict: A clean dark card with a clear lime focus tile, but the red glitch banner shouts louder than anything else, the 30,000 price repeats on 24 tiles, and the detail pane is mostly empty with a dead hire button.
findings: P1 banner under tabs: '***experimental feature may glitch***': Delete the asterisks. Make it a 16px tx-2 or --warn label, left-aligned, or put a small 'experimental' tag in the detail pane. Cut the letter-spacing to the .04em label spec and the height to 24px.

P1 detail pane: name, price, hire button: Make hire the single lime fill (--acc bg, --acc-ink text, 56px tall) when affordable. If the $900 balance cannot cover it, show it as a clear 'need $29,100' state in --danger. Render the name in tx-1 at 32px. Put the portrait at about 160px at the top of the pane to fill the void.

P1 detail pane copy: 'no history between you.' and 'buy a friend.': Remove both lines. Replace them with 2 or 3 stat rows (label 16px tx-2, value 20px tx-1) on 8px-grid spacing, or leave only the 'pillager bot' tag, name and price.

P2 grid tiles: '30,000' on every tile: Remove the per-tile price, since the detail pane already shows it. Make the names 18 to 20px tx-1 in f-cond 600. Show a price only on tiles that differ, or a lock glyph when unaffordable. Keep the lime border and fill on the focused tile (that is the best part of the screen).

P2 header right: '$900  0 xp  stash $3,750 bag $0': Use one style: 20px tx-1 for values and 16px tx-2 for labels, 24px gaps. Label '$900' as 'cash' or add a coin icon. Move the 'stash' and 'bag' values into 16px tx-2 and add a 1px --ui-line divider before them.

11-wirt-gambler.verdict: the gambler window is a small, low-contrast cluster of stacked boxes floating in a huge empty card; it has no hero element, the type is too small and the copy is repeated, so it looks like a debug form and not a polished AAA vendor screen.
findings: P0 whole card composition: make the gamble the hero. Add a 56px result or prize slot (f-cond 800) above the roll button, with a vendor portrait or art on the left. Widen the content to about 1100px, or split it into two columns: wirt and the offer on the left, the roll and result on the right. Move the stack up so it is optically centred.

P0 intro text and the 'the gamble' panel: delete both intro lines and the 'nothing rolled yet' sentence. Keep the price only on the button ('gamble $2,500'). Use the empty result box for the outcome only, or remove it until a roll happens.

P1 limited time offer card: delete the blue duplicate. Make the item name 32px tx-1 and put a 3px rarity bar (blue for rare) on the left. Drop the full lime border to a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 3px lime tab. Use '1:00' with a timer glyph in 16px tx-2 in the top-right corner of the card.

P1 type scale across the card: use only the guide sizes: title 32, row and button 20, labels 16. Every body or label string is at least 16px, and anything read is tx-2 #aaa498 or brighter. Remove the sub-16px strings.

P1 gamble button and buy button: make gamble the single lime primary (acc fill, acc-ink text, 56px tall, 20px label). When it can't be afforded, show a disabled fill (--ui-raised, tx-2) with 'need $1,600 more' as the button text in --danger. No nested pill. Give both buttons the same height and a 2px lime focus ring. Align buy to the item's baseline.

12-mainframe-contracts.verdict: it has the right card-and-x structure and a clear lime focus row, but the list is a flat wall of identical rows, the text is tiny and low-contrast for a couch, and the unused detail pane, clipped last row and overlapping toast make it feel unfinished.
findings: P1 contract list rows (left pane): drop the repeated 'standard' tag (show a tag only for hard or elite), set the row name to 20px tx-1 and the pays line to 16px tx-2 (min 4.5:1). Right-align the $ reward at 20px in a fixed column. Raise row height to 72px with 16px padding.
P1 selected row fill: use --ui-raised #1e2225 for the fill, a 4px solid --acc left bar, and tx-1 text. Optionally a 1px --acc-at-40% outline.

P1 bottom of list and toast ('the welcome pack is in your stash.'): fit the list to the card with 24px bottom padding and a fade or scroll indicator on the cut row. Move the toast to 24px above the card edge, outside the border, or inside the safe area, and shorten it or remove it.

P1 detail pane (right): stretch the pane to the full list height, pin the action button to the bottom at 56px tall, and make the progress bar 8px with an --acc fill. Enlarge the reward icon to 56px with a 16px count. State the disabled state in tx-2 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P2 header stats (900 credits, 0 xp, stash 3,750 bag 0): use one pattern for all three: a 20px tx-1 number plus a 16px tx-2 label, 32px gaps. Split stash and bag into two items. Use '$' consistently for money ('$600', not '600 c' and not 'credits' next to '$').

14-mainframe-racks.verdict: The racks column is now centred in the card, but it is a thin strip of five near-identical flat buttons and grey paragraphs in a mostly empty card, with no focal point, no hero and no real primary action.
findings: P0 import-a-friend paragraph: Delete the paragraph. If any hint stays, use a 16px tx-2 label of 4 words or fewer, such as 'import a pillager'.

P0 cost line under 'build a rack': Replace it with four cost chips at 16px in one row or a 2x2 grid, for example 'scrap 0/12', each in tx-1 when held and danger red when short. Remove the prose and the trailing full stops.

P1 whole card: Make '0 of 10 racks' the 56px f-cond 800 hero. Enlarge the cells to 40px tall tiles. Make 'build a rack' the one lime --acc filled button, and render it disabled but readable with a cost chip row beneath it.

P1 layout, 672px column in a 1720px card: Use a two-pane layout. Put the rack grid and actions in a left panel of about 720px and a --ui-raised detail pane on the right showing the array and data core slots. Alternatively fill the card height with a 5x2 rack tile grid at 96px.

P1 build a rack, fold 10 racks into an array, slot a data core: Disabled text should be at least #aaa498 at 70% (4.5:1). Add a 3px lime focus bar plus a --ui-raised fill on the focused row. Set button height to 56px with --fs-body 20px text, not about 14px.

16-bar-last-pour.verdict: The bar list is bigger and easier to read than before, but it is still two rows floating in a huge empty card, with no focused row, a stray toast over the card edge, and wallet text that is too small.
findings: P0 whole card, 98-1822 x 56-1024: Put the title top-left in the 56px header row at 32px, on the same line as the wallet and close. Fill the body: a left column of 3-4 drinks as 96px rows, and a right raised detail pane (--ui-raised) with the selected drink's icon at 96px, its effect in one short line, and the price. Or shrink the card to about 60% width when there are only 2 items.

P0 liquor and blotter rows: Give the focused row a --ui-raised fill and a 3px lime bar on its left edge. Only the focused row's ingest becomes a filled lime button (--acc fill, --acc-ink text, 48px high). Make the other rows' buttons idle (--ui-line-hi border, tx-1 text).

P1 top-right wallet: '900 credits  0 xp  stash 3,750 bag 0': Show only '$900', and drop xp and stash from the bar. Set it at 20px f-cond 700 with a 16px tx-2 label. Put 24px gaps between items and align the baseline with the X. If stash and bag are needed, use 16px with a 1px divider.
P1 row text: description lines: Replace each with a 3-5 word effect, e.g. 'speed up, blur vision', and put the duration in a 16px tag. Cap the description at 40ch. Use tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better.

P1 price '$300' / '$520' beside ingest: Set the price at 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 in a fixed 96px right-aligned column. Make the button label 20px 700 with 24px side padding. Turn the price red (--danger) when the player cannot afford it, and disable that row's button.

17-fashion-mirror.verdict: it is a consistent centred card with an x, a tidy tab row and a clear grid, but the eye has no single focal point, there are two items with the same fill and the supporting type is too small and dim for a couch.
findings: P1 tile grid, 'worn' bare and crop tiles: worn: --ui-raised fill, 3px lime left bar and a small lime 'worn' tag. Pad focus: 2px --acc outline plus a 4px glow, never the same fill as worn.

P1 header and left column, no hero: make the operator preview the hero by lighting its backdrop and raising it to ~380px. Set the panel headings to --tx-1 at 20px 600. Reserve lime for the selected tab, the worn tile and focus. Set the title to 32px.

P1 tile sublabels (unlock hints) and category labels 'headgear' and 'hairstyle': raise the hints to 16px --tx-2 (4.5:1 or better). Raise the category labels to 16px with +.04em tracking. Move the hint to a 2-line area under the name, with a darker scrim behind it.

P1 left list (outfit, build, skin, hair...): make the preview shorter (~300px) so all rows fit, or turn the list into a 2-column grid of 48px chips. Rows are 48px with a 20px value and a 16px label. Remove the inner scrollbar.

P2 top-right currency row: show '$900' as the only hero-weight number (--fs-body 700). Make xp and stash 16px --tx-2 with the same number-to-label gap. Put 24px between groups and 32px before the x. Drop 'credits'.

18-settings-hub.verdict: A clean, consistent card with a clear lime focus row and an X in the corner, but the detail pane is a dead void with a stranded paragraph, the rows run past the card edge in one flat tone, and the page has the wrong scroll and focus cues.
findings: P1 right detail pane: Cut the paragraph to a short callout of 8 words or fewer, set at 20px tx-1 directly under the title with a 16px gap. Or show a control preview or the current value as a 56px hero number. Do not leave 350px of void between them.

P1 left category rail: Make the rail 20px f-cond 600. Give the selected row a full --ui-raised fill with a 4px lime left bar and tx-1 text. Idle rows get tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Pin 'send play data' to the bottom of the rail with a 1px divider above it.

P1 settings list (rows): Add a 16px tx-2 section label ('the raid', 'audio') with a 1px --ui-line rule above each group. Raise row names to 20px tx-1 at 85%. Widen the scrollbar to 8px in --ui-line-hi. Show only the active category's rows, since the rail already selects it.

P1 value steppers (< value >): Move the stepper cluster to right-align at the row edge, about 220px wide. Make the arrows 24px with a 40px hit area. Keep the label, value and arrows in the same 56px row. Show idle arrows at tx-2 and focused ones in lime.

P2 card frame, header and footer: Remove the stray lime tick or turn it into a proper 36px top tab on the card. Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 with 24px padding. Make the footer hint name the live device key or button, and drop it if the X already covers close.

19-raid-hud-drop-first-raid.verdict: The HUD has a sound layout, but it is crowded with at least seven competing blocks, nothing sets the hero number apart, the panel and type styles disagree, and the text is full of typos.
findings: P0 top-right career column, run info panel, bot list, tips and toasts: Find out whether this is the font fallback or the lowercase transform. Use Barlow with a distinct dotted i. Raise the body text to 20px. Proof every string on screen.
P0 overall composition: Hide the controls list after about 10s or show it only on F1. Remove both explaining toasts. Cut the run info text to short chips. Show at most 3 contextual elements at once.

P1 top-right column: credits, xp, stash, backpack, minimap, run info: Use 8px gaps everywhere, including above and below the minimap. Give the minimap a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Fix the black strip on the right side. Set the stat width to about 220px so labels and values read as pairs, and keep a 24px margin from the edge.

P1 bottom-right ammo card (scav pistol 12 / 24): Keep the 56px 800-weight '12' and make '/ 24' tx-2 at 20px. Drop the gun name to 20px f-cond 600, upright. Move the 'b / i backpack' hint to 16px tx-2 on the belt row. Remove the ghost silhouette, or draw it at 100% so it reads.

P1 top-left bot list, and the run info, controls and toast panels: Use one panel: --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding, a 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 header with a chevron on every collapsible. Use tx-1 for names and keep colour only for the player marker.

21-raid-hud-calm.verdict: The top-right money block is now compact and no longer a stack of empty bars, but the HUD is still a pile of same-weight boxes, with the keys cheat-sheet, bots list and run info all competing and the ammo hero, hp and the minor lines still unresolved.
findings: P1 center-left key legend (wasd, ctrl / c ... f1 full list): Collapse it to a one-line footer hint, or show it only for the first 30s of a raid. If it stays, cap it at 4 rows, 16px type, panel fill --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding.

P1 top-right cluster: cash / stash / xp / backpack: Make it one vertical list, one item per row, a 20px value in tx-1 and a 16px label in tx-2, right-aligned values on a shared x. Give 16px padding inside the panel. Use cash as the single bright number (tx-1 800); the rest stay tx-2.

P1 run info panel (contracts): One line per contract: a 16px label left, an 'n/m' right-aligned in tx-1, a 2px progress bar below. Shorten the strings so none wraps. Use a fixed 16px indent for all rows.

P1 ammo block (bottom-right) and hotbar: Align the ammo block and hotbar baselines to the same y. Reduce 'b / i backpack' to 16px tx-2 and move it to the footer legend. Raise the empty-slot outline to --ui-line-hi.

P2 bottom-left status: standing / stamina / hp 100: Use 32px bars with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px inner padding. Put the hp number at 20px, left-aligned, and the label in tx-2. Make the standing chip the same --rad 4px panel as the others.

22-raid-map-open.verdict: The window shell (title left, x top-right, centred card, lime m close key) is consistent and clean. The map is still a crowd of tiny labels and the contracts column is a flat list of identical rows, so the eye has no clear first stop. The 'cache' labels now clump into leader-line tangles at the top-right and right-middle.
findings: P1 map, strongbox/blast freezer cluster (x 920-1080, y 360-560): Merge duplicate-type tags into one label with a count, for example 'cache x4'. Keep one leader line per label. Keep the tag column at least 24px clear of the zone and extract labels. Drop the leader lines when the icon is within 40px.
P1 map, top-right (x 960-1060, y 180-290): Combine them into one 'cache x3' label. Put it outside the room rectangle at least 12px from the 'locked' label. Use 16px type.

P1 contracts panel, rows: Draw the progress bar as a 4px track in --ui-line with a --acc fill proportional to progress. Set reward text in --tx-1 and the name in --tx-1 at 20px. Give every row a count in the same slot ('0/1') so 'open' does not break the column.

P1 map labels, overall: Use three tiers: extract labels 20px --extract, point-of-interest labels 16px --tx-1, zone names 16px --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Give POI labels a 1px dark text outline or a 60% --ui-void chip behind them.
P2 map, left edge (old image only; 'codex entry' toast): None needed. Confirm in a later capture that toasts never draw over the window card.

23-raid-backpack-open.verdict: The backpack is a flat, dark and quiet card with a good lime focus tile, but it is a small, under-filled box with weak hierarchy, a tiny 3-item grid and a loose type scale, so it reads as a debug panel and not as a Diablo/ARC inventory.
findings: P0 backpack card, item grid (y 670-755): Draw a fixed grid of empty slots (e.g. 8x4 at 88px tiles, 8px gap, --ui-line border, --ui-bg fill), with items sitting in it and a 3px rarity bar on the bottom edge. Put the capacity ('3 / 24') in the header at 16px tx-2.
P0 whole card: Title to 32px f-cond 700. Make the selected item's name 32px (title) and its stats 16px tx-2. Drop the second name size. Keep lime only on the focused tile.

P1 stat and hint rows (y 605-640, 850-890): Show stats as label (tx-2, 16px) over value (tx-1, 20px) pairs in a 4-column row with 24px gutters. Show hints as key-cap chips at 16px ('arrows' 'z' 'drag') with 8px gaps. Fix the armour/armor spelling to one form.

P1 card frame and placement (546-1374 x 450-923): Make it a card at about 70% of the width, anchored 24px above the hotbar, or a full 90% window. Put a 32px X button in the top-right corner, with 'b' as a key-cap hint beside it at 16px.

P1 section spacing and dividers: Use an 8px grid: 24px card padding all round, 24px between sections, 1px --ui-line-hi dividers. Make the equipped block its own --ui-raised panel with the weapon icon at 64px and not 40px.

25-raid-pause-box.verdict: A clean, calm pause card with a clear lime primary action and an X in the corner, but it is a small 480px box on a 1920 screen, with a mismatched button stack and a dead gap above a tiny abandon link.
findings: P1 card size vs window rule: Keep it as a compact pause menu if that is the intent, but then state that exception in the guide. Otherwise widen it to about 640px and add a hero title at 32px.
P1 button stack: Make every button 56px with 16px gaps. Make report a problem, feedback and what's new share one equal row of three, or stack all of them at full width.
P1 abandon run: Make it a 56px outlined button with a 1px --danger border and --danger text at 20px. Place it 24px below the secondary rows, or lower it into a footer row.
P2 header: Give the X a 48px square hit area with a --ui-line-hi border on focus. Make the tab 3px high and fully --acc.
P2 secondary button fills: Use one idle fill, transparent or --ui-bg, with a --ui-line-hi border on every non-primary button.

26-settings-from-pause-top.verdict: The new settings window is a huge fix (the old one was a broken, empty header stuck at the bottom of a black screen), and it now reads as a real centred card with tabs, rows and focus. But the content is a narrow column with dead side space, the controls float far from their labels, and the bottom of the list and the footer are crowded and cut off.
findings: P1 row controls (chevron, value, chevron): Right-align the stepper group to the row's right padding (16px). Or cap the row at 900px at 1080 so the label-to-control gap is under 400px. Make the chevrons about 24px with a 48px hit area.

P1 list bottom edge / 'how much is out there' row: Size the list to a whole number of 56px rows (at 4K, 112px each) or add a 24px fade mask at the bottom. Widen the scrollbar to 6-8px, with a visible track, and inset it 8px from the panel edge.
P1 window layout / side margins: Keep the 900px-at-1080 measure but align the title, tabs and footer to the same column. Or fill the card with a left category nav and a right detail pane.

P1 detail pane (edit the words): Drop the repeated title and shrink the pane to one 16px tx-2 line. Replace the copy with something neutral like 'changes the in-game wording'. Align the pane's left padding with the row text at x=522.
P2 tab strip: Use 20px tabs with 24px side padding and a 3px underline. Move 'send play data' into the list as a row, or make it a ghost button, and add LB/RB glyphs at the strip ends.

32-keys-window.verdict: A clean, near-full-screen dark card with an x in the corner that matches the window rule, but a flat wall of same-weight rows, tiny section labels, a long gap between each action and its key, and a half-clipped row at the bottom keep it from looking polished.
findings: P1 list bottom edge, rows 'controls list' / 'order your hire': Fade the list out over the last 24px with a gradient mask, or snap the scroll to whole rows and add 16px bottom padding. Make the scrollbar thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, brightening on focus.

P1 section headers 'move' / 'fight' / 'world': Set the headers to 16px f-cond 700 in tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Make the lime bar 3px wide and match its height to the header text, or span the header plus its first row. Keep 24px above each header and 8px below.

P1 row layout, action name vs key cap: Narrow each column to about 760px and give each row a 1px --ui-line bottom divider, or put the key cap directly after a fixed 360px label column. Add a --ui-raised fill for the focused row.
P1 pad focus / selected state: Draw focus as a 2px --acc border on the cap plus a --ui-raised row fill. Show a 'press a key' state with an --acc-ink on --acc cap. Keep the rest quiet.

P2 title bar 'keys' and x: Remove the stray tick or turn it into a 3px by 36px tab drawn on purpose. Make the header row 56px with the title centred vertically. Put the x in a 44px square with a focus border.

33-raid-fight-alerts.verdict: the closer camera makes the player and nearby threats easier to read, but the screen still drowns the one thing that should win, the pillbox alert, under nine simultaneous panels and a triplicated warning.
findings: P0 top-center alert vs left-side event log vs world tag, 1080 shot: drop the floating world tag (keep it on the pillbox icon only, no duplicate text) and let the event log entries fade after ~3s instead of persisting under an active toast; one alert surface, not three.

P0 bottom-center floating keybind panel, overlaps the walkway between player and pillbox: move this to a corner (e.g. bottom-left under hp/stamina) or collapse it to the "f1 full list" toggle only, so the center of the screen is clear during combat; it already has a caret, so default it collapsed after the first few seconds of a raid.

P1 right edge: credits/xp/stash/backpack stack, minimap, run info panel: demote the stat stack to tx-2 (muted) numbers until they change, keep only --acc on the one number that just updated, and tighten panel padding so the column reads as one unit, not three competing boxes.

P1 world tags "pillbox v-64" and "sentry k-98" compared old vs new shot: pin entity name-tag text to a fixed screen size (e.g. --fs-label, 16px) regardless of camera zoom, same as the style guide's other labels, so zoom changes don't silently drift type scale.
P1 whole 1080 frame: during an active alert, auto-dim or shrink the non-combat panels (bots list, keybind card) to ~60% opacity so the eye has fewer equal-weight boxes to parse.

35-kia-card.verdict: A clean, centred end card that mostly follows the shell (red title, one hero number, row of 4 stats, tile row, one primary), but the hero is a banned '$' figure, the secondary text is tiny and dim, and the item tiles are too small and confusingly placed above the number.

38-extracted-card.verdict: The only change is a new 'extract without using a single heal' challenge line that adds clutter and an explaining sentence, while the card's main problems (a tiny floating card, a weak hero, too many stacked small lines) are still there.
findings: P1 challenge line above 'burst carbine recovered': Cut the sentence to a short chip such as 'no heals', with the ✓ in --ok, and put it in the tag row with 'first out · untouched · ghost'. Or drop it from this card. If it stays as a line, give it 16px tx-2 and a 24px gap above and below, away from the recovered line.
P1 hierarchy: title vs haul number: Make the haul exactly 56px f-cond 800 tx-1. Drop the title to 32px/700, or tx-2 weight. Keep teal for the title only.

P1 top text stack: Merge 'out clean · never spotted' into the tag row. Keep one xp line at 16px. Put the recovered line at 20px tx-1 right above the item tiles. Keep the vertical gaps at 8/16/24 only.
P2 stats row and tag row: Raise the tags to 16px tx-2 (#aaa498). Move the feedback prompt to the footer legend at 14px, or make it a ghost button of the same width as the primary, with a 24px gap.
P2 spacing rhythm: Use 16px between related lines, 24px between groups and 32px above the button. Set the card padding to 24-32px all round.

40-whats-new-card.verdict: A clean, compact dark card with a lime focus bar, an x and one lime action, but it is small, its content is a plain numbered list, and the busy hub behind it competes with it.
findings: P1 card size and placement: Decide whether this is a window or a toast. If it is a window, make it about 90 percent wide. If it stays small, raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) and hide the hotbar and hint toast while it is open.
P1 hierarchy: Make the items f-cond 600 at 20px in tx-1 with a lime or tx-2 number column. Keep the title at 32px/700. Make the version tx-2 or a small tag. Keep the lime fill on the button only.
P1 footer row: Delete the hint line. Keep x and 'got it'. If a key hint stays, show it as an enter glyph inside the button. Show the live pad button on pad.
P2 x close button: Use a 40px button, a 20px glyph in tx-1 and 16px from the top and right edges. Run the divider the full card width so the left and right padding match.
P2 spacing and alignment: Use 16px row gaps with 1px --ui-line dividers, 24px between header and list, 24px between list and footer, and a 3px bar.

45-arcade-attract-board.verdict: The card is clean and all lower case, but it is unchanged from the last review: the empty body is centered, the prompt is a dim ring-and-text with no real focus state, and the small card is neither a proper dialog nor a window.
findings: P1 'press any key' prompt, bottom-right of card (1065-1206 x 605-628): Make it a 56px-high primary button with fill #e6ff3d, text #11150a at 20px/700, min-width 200px, right-aligned 24px from the card edge. Or use tx-1 text with a 3px #e6ff3d underline and drop the ring.

P1 card body, 'no scores yet' (x≈906-1014, y≈534): Left-align it at x=714 in tx-2, 20px/400, 24px below the header. Add 3 dim placeholder rows at a 56px pitch ('1 ---', '2 ---', '3 ---') with 1px #2e3337 dividers.

P1 card structure (682-1238 x 412-667): Choose one. For a dialog, make it 480x240 with 24px padding. For a window, make it 90% wide and tall with a 56px header and a 72px footer holding the primary on the right.
P2 close X, top-right of card (1167-1215 x 430-476): Use a 1px #4a5257 border, a 20px close glyph in tx-2, and a 'B' glyph 8px to its left. Inset it 24px from the top and right edges.
P2 'pillagers' wordmark, top-left (96-210 x 60-88): Set it in tx-2 at 70% opacity, or remove it. If kept, use 32px with a 36px lime tab above it, aligned to x=96.

50-arcade-hud-live.verdict: The raid hud is cleaner than a typical amateur one, with a clear hero ammo number and an all-lower-case hotbar. But the corner widgets use different panel styles, the type sizes are scattered, and the hp, armour and stamina bars are all the same weight, so the screen still reads as parts from several different screens.
findings: P1 top-centre score/timer plate: Use one panel: a 16px top margin, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Make the timer the 56px f-cond 800 hero and drop the score to 20px tx-2. Put the extract chip inside the panel on its own 16px row, and move the arrow into that row.

P1 bottom-left hp/armour/stamina bars: Hp is the one hero bar: 28px tall, 20px label. Armour and stamina are 10px slim bars, tx-2 labels at 16px, set outside the fill. Keep a 5% margin (96px left, 48px bottom). Put a 1px --ui-void backing under each bar so they hold up on any floor colour.

P1 right column: minimap, run info, ammo: Use one panel recipe on all three: --ui-panel 90% fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 24px padding, 16px gap, and one shared width of 320px aligned to the same right margin. Drop the 'run info' heading. Set the goals as 16px rows with 8px gaps, tx-1 for the goal name and tx-2 for progress and reward.

P1 left status chips: f1 controls, fog, stronghold, golden enemy: Use one chip style: 16px f-cond 600, 32px tall, --ui-panel fill, 1px border, 8px gap. Remove the info icons. Fold 'standing' into the same chip. Group the chips in one left-aligned stack with a 48px margin.

P2 hotbar and weapon hint strip: Give the active slot one lime 2px border with --ui-raised fill and no other highlight. Use rarity only as a 3px bottom bar. Set slot numbers to 16px tx-2. Dim empty icons to 40% opacity. Put the weapon name and the hints on one flat strip at 16px.

52-arcade-run-over.verdict: The title is now bright and the sub-line is a quiet grey rather than competing lime, but the prompt is still small and dim, the stats row is still left-heavy and the card is still a small box with dead space at the bottom.
findings: P1 Footer prompt 'press any key', bottom-right: Set the text at 24px f-cond 700 in tx-1 #efe9dc. Make the glyph full --acc #e6ff3d at 28px. Put the prompt in a 72px footer row with 24px padding and centre it vertically.
P1 Hero 'score 0 sp': Put a 16px tx-2 'score' label above. Show '0' at 56px f-cond 800 tx-1 with 'sp' at 20px tx-2 beside it. Move 'ended early -50%' directly under the hero as a 16px --warn line.

P1 Stats row (kills / extractions / deaths): Use equal columns across the 652px inner width. Set values at 24px f-cond 600 tx-1 and labels at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 with +.04em tracking, at least 4.5:1 contrast. Add a fourth 'time' column, or centre each stat in its column.
P2 Card vertical rhythm: Use 24px title→hero, 24px hero→divider, 24px divider→stats and 32px stats→footer. Make the footer row 72px, with a 1px --ui-line divider above it if needed.
P2 Card size and backdrop: Darken the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80). Either enlarge the card to match the window card, or keep it compact with 32px padding, the 4px radius and an opaque --ui-panel fill.

57-title-2p-coop-picked.verdict: The title screen has a clean centred column and a clear focus bar, but the error banner steals the hierarchy, the buttons are thin and generic, and the menu leaves a lot of dead space.
findings: P1 error banner between menu and saves: Shorten the message to 'popup blocked' with a 16px warn-amber glyph. Make retry a normal outlined button, or use the accent fill only while the banner is the sole action. Move the banner to a toast at the top or bottom so the column does not jump.

P1 menu rows (1 player ... 1 player arcade demo): Make 1 player the lead row, 64px tall, with a --ui-raised fill. Group the two arcade demos beneath it as quieter rows. Give the focused row a full lime 2px border plus a --ui-raised fill and a 4px left bar.

P1 title wordmark: Use a flat --tx-1 or lime wordmark at 72px with no gradient or shadow, or make a deliberate logo treatment. Raise the tagline to 16px in --tx-2, with a clear 24px gap above and below it.

P1 saves section and name row: Keep the lime border only on the focused element. Make the idle selected save a 2px --ui-line-hi border with a lime check glyph. Set the controls row to 40px tall with 16px labels. Add 32px of space above the 'saves' label. Raise the label to 16px --tx-2.
P2 background art: Add a 90% --ui-panel card behind the column with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, or darken the scrim to .80 across the middle 640px.

59-raid-abandon-confirm.verdict: the x now sits inside the card, which fixes the worst flaw, but it is still stranded mid-card at the title line and the title, danger button and padding are unchanged from the last review.
findings: P1 close x (~1136,428): put the x 16px from the top and right edges (centre ~1160,404), in a 40x40 hit area, same position as on every other card. Or remove it, since 'keep playing' already closes the card.

P1 danger button 'yes, abandon this run' + 'free this early': label it 'abandon run' at 20px/600 in --danger in a 56px button. Delete 'free this early', or move it to a 16px --tx-2 line under the title. Keep the 1px --danger border.
P1 title 'abandon this run?': title at 32px/700 --tx-1, top padding 32px. Add one 16px --tx-2 line such as 'your bag is lost'. Keep the divider 16px below.
P2 card padding and vertical rhythm: use 32px padding all round, 16px between the divider and the first button, 16px between the buttons. Card width 520px.
P2 accent tab (top-left, ~720-756,380): make it 36x3px solid --acc flush to the card's top-left corner, or delete it.

65-codex.verdict: The tiles now fill the card and the empty void is gone, but the grid is still a narrow column of tiny gun icons in oversized boxes, and a toast sits on top of the bottom row.
findings: P0 bottom centre toast 'trophy earned · motherlode': Move toasts to a fixed zone above the card or at the top (y≈24, outside the card), or end the grid at y≤940 and reserve a 56px footer row for toasts. Never draw it over content.

P1 tile content and icon size: Scale the icon to about 140px, centred in the tile's upper half or filling the left 45%, with the name and tags beside or below it. Use a rarity glow behind found guns. Silhouettes on locked tiles need about 25% more brightness.

P1 vertical alignment inside tiles: Anchor the name baseline at a fixed offset (tile top + 32px). Reserve the kills row for every found gun, or show a muted 'kills 0'. Give the new badge 8px inset and 16px type.

P1 grid layout in the card: Run the grid from the card padding (x=119 to x=1801), with 24px gutters (8px grid), which gives about 410px tiles. Or add a left filter rail (rarity, class) so the width is used.
P1 locked tiles 'not found': Show only the rarity bar and a class name on locked tiles, drop the 'not found' repetition, and lift the rarity text to full --r-* colours at 16px minimum.

66-trophy-case.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear x and a readable grid, but the tiles are big and empty, the title is small, and unlocked and locked states barely differ in hierarchy.
findings: P1 header title 'trophy case · 6 of 8': Make the title 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Move '6 of 8' to the right of the header, next to the x, in tx-2 at 20px, or make it the one 56px hero count. Pad the header to 24px.

P1 all 8 tiles: Cut the tile height to about 260px and use a 4x2 grid with a 24px gap. Scale the icon to about 96px. Alternatively use 6 columns of smaller tiles so the card is not mostly void. Fill earned tiles with --ui-raised and keep locked tiles on --ui-panel.

P1 locked tiles (full armory, overseer down): Draw locked icons as a 2px outline in --ui-line-hi (#4a5257), not a dark fill. Keep the locked name and description at tx-2 or brighter (4.5:1 minimum). Replace the 'locked' tag with a 16px tx-2 label.
P1 trophy tier colours: Make all earned icons one neutral tone (tx-1 at 70%). Put a 3px top bar in the tier colour on each tile, as the rarity bars do elsewhere. Use lime only for focus.

P2 tile text sizes: Set the name to 20px tx-1 (600), the description to 16px tx-2 and the date to 16px tx-2 at 60% opacity. Add 8px of spacing between them, and put the date at the bottom edge of the tile.

62-arcade-operator-menu.verdict: The new version is slightly cleaner: the doubled outer ring on the focused row is gone and the close button is smaller. It is still a tiny generic dark card floating in an empty black screen, with no identity and a weak focus read.
findings: P1 whole screen / backdrop: Show the attract frame or live world at about 55% brightness under rgba(6,7,8,.80). Add a faint marquee or scanline motif at 6-8% opacity behind the card.

P1 card size and hierarchy: Either scale the card to the window standard, or keep it as a compact dialog. Then add a 16px tx-2 state line under the title (for example party size) and raise the row text to 24px with 56px row height. Make the title 32px f-cond 800.

P1 new party row (focus state): Add a right-aligned 'enter' key cap, 24px from the edge, in --acc-ink on a 1px acc-ink-at-40% border. Keep the label at 20px f-cond 700 with 24px left padding. Add a 2px tx-1 outline at a 2px offset only for pad focus.
P2 exit demo row: Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and tx-1 text. Add a right-aligned 'esc' key cap and optionally a --danger tint (text and 1px border at 60%).
P2 footer key legend: Set the labels to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Use 8px inside a group and 24px between groups. Keep a single esc/back entry and drop either the X or the legend.

61-raid-wheel-open.verdict: The picked wedge is now raised grey with a lime rim, so the selection reads cleanly and the olive mud is gone. The screen is still a busy raid HUD with mixed type sizes and a few small, low-contrast labels.
findings: P1 wheel selected wedge: Raise the picked fill to --ui-raised #1e2225 plus about 8% white. Make the rim 4px --acc. Drop the green ring tint on the picked wedge so only lime shows.
P1 HUD top-right career column and run info panel: Set run info rows to 16px/600 tx-1. Keep headers in tx-2. Space rows 8px apart. Give the panel a 3px left accent tab so it matches the other panels.

P1 wheel labels and counts: Add 12px inset padding on all label edges. Raise the dim state to at least 4.5:1 (tx-2 #aaa498 at 60%). Restyle the chips as 16px tx-1 on --ui-void with no lime fill, so lime stays on the selection.
P2 wheel centre hub: Set the name to 32px/700. Make the subtitle 16px tx-2. Centre the arrow with 16px clearance from the hub ring.

P2 mixed micro-labels (top-left bots list, status pills, hotbar hints): Use the 16px label token everywhere. Use one pill style: 4px radius, --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border. Keep lime only on the single key chip, and shrink that chip to 16px text.

58-coop-player2-window-title.verdict: the clutter is gone and the lime button now leads the screen, but the amber gradient title competes with it, the lower block is cramped and the type is off-scale.
findings: P1 title 'pillagers' (about 56px, amber gradient with drop shadow): Fill it flat --tx-1 #efe9dc with no gradient and no shadow, f-cond 800 at 56px. Leave lime to the button and the focused save row.

P1 button, 'player 2 window' label and saves block (y 511–735): Use an 8px grid: 24px between title block and button, 32px from button to saves. Move 'player 2 window' into a 16px tx-2 chip above the title or into the top-left, not under the button. Give the saves label a 16px tx-2 size with 8px below it.

P1 name row: 'pillager' input, 'change name', 'create a new save': Make the row 48px high with 16px labels at weight 600. Make the input a --ui-raised field with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a visible focus ring in lime. Fold the two actions into one 'new save' ghost button, or keep 'change name' only on the selected row.

P1 type scale across the page (tagline, 'saves', row values, hints, 'v0.0737'): Snap to 56/32/20/16/14. Make the tagline 20px --tx-2 #aaa498 with a --scrim panel or stronger vignette behind it. Make the row stats 16px tx-2. Keep the version at 14px, only in the footer.

P1 background art behind the menu column: Raise the --scrim to .80 across the centre, or put the menu column on a 560px-wide --ui-panel at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Keep the art visible at the edges only.

46-arcade-attract-how-to-play.verdict: the how-to-play card is tidy and fully lower case, but the previous fixes were mostly not applied: the prompt is still white with a radio dot, the card is still narrow with small text, and the scrim is still too light, so it reads as a tidy table rather than something polished.
findings: P1 footer prompt 'press any key' (x≈1166-1346, y≈838-870): Set the text to 20-24px f-cond 700 in --acc #e6ff3d, swap the radio dot for a 16px key glyph, and use a 72px footer row under the 1px --ui-line rule. Keep the right edge at x=1346.

P1 card scale (x 541-1378, y 176-905): Widen the card to about 1600-1700px (90%), set row names to 24px and keycaps to 22px, and use 64px rows. If you keep it narrow, scale the text to 20px minimum and pad every side by 24px.

P1 column headers 'keyboard' / 'controller' (x≈759, 1053; y≈271-285): Set them to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking in --tx-2 #aaa498 or brighter, inside a 40px header row above the existing 1px rule.
P1 close X (x≈1298-1346, y≈192-239): Delete it on this walk-up screen. If you keep it, make it a 48x48 ghost button with a 24px glyph in a 56px header row.
P2 background scrim (whole screen): Set the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) and lift the card border to --ui-line-hi #4a5257.

37-raid-extracting-countdown.verdict: The extract banner now leads the screen, but the rest of the HUD is crowded and uses too many type sizes, panel styles and accent colours.
findings: P1 top-right career stack (credits, xp, stash, backpack), minimap and run info: Collapse the stack to the 1 by 1 list of the cw-trcol order, with every row 40px high and 16px labels in tx-2. Drop xp and stash during a raid. Show money as '$900'. Give the run info rows 20px body text, 8px padding and a 24px panel inset.

P1 top-left 'current pillager bots' panel: Fix the panel height so the last row has 8px padding and no overflow. Make the header tx-2 at 16px. Set the rows to 16px and show the values as '4,310 sp'. Use the shared 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius.

P1 centre bottom: extract banner, hostiles bar, weapon prompt and hotbar: Add a 16px gap between the banner and the hostiles bar. Raise the hostiles text to 18-20px at weight 700. Move the key hint to 16px, sitting 8px above the hotbar with a 12px margin. Remove the heavy outline from the banner plate.

P1 left feed: codex entry, running slowly, medkit, titanium cell, induction coil, contract item nearby: Cap the feed at 3 rows and merge the loot pickups into a count. Delete the centre explanation sentence, or shorten it to 'contract item nearby'. Fade ghost text out within 1.5s.

P1 ammo and weapon panel bottom right: Align the labels to a 24px inset on a shared baseline grid. Keep 56px for 12 and 20px for '/ 24' in tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Remove the faded silhouette or raise it to 40% opacity.

77-haul-reveal-done.verdict: solid materials (real icons, correct color tokens, correct $ and lowercase rules) but four competing bold elements and nine stacked center-aligned blocks leave no single focal point and read as a generic dense modal rather than a confident extraction reveal.
findings: P0 whole card: 'extracted' title, haul '$7,620', the two bold 'recovered to the armoury' lines, and the lime CTA text: drop to one hero: keep --fs-hero 56px bold only on the $7,620 haul number, set 'extracted' to --fs-title 32px at tx-1 weight 700 (not full teal fill-bold), and set the two recovery lines to --fs-body 20px tx-2 regular, not bold

P1 the two checkmark lines, 'extract with a haul worth $1,600 or more' / 'extract without using a single heal': left-align inside a bordered row, cut to a condensed label ('haul $1,600+', 'no heals used') at --fs-label 16px next to the check glyph, remove 'extract' repeated in both

P1 item grid, rows of icons ending in '+7 more' (img1) / '+11 more' (img2): either show a full scrollable grid inside a bordered sub-panel (match the ARC Raiders CONTAINER/BACKPACK panel pattern with its own header) or drop to a single row of the 4-5 highest value items plus a 'view all' as a real control, not trailing grey text

P1 entire card body (title block, xp, 2 challenges, 2 recovery lines, item grid, haul, stat row, tag row, feedback prompt, button): wrap 'containers/kills/accuracy/time' in one --ui-raised panel and the challenge checks in another, each with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --sp-2 padding, so the eye reads 3-4 panels instead of 9 loose text rows

P2 every line in the card: title, subtitle, challenges, stat labels, tag row: keep the card centered on screen but left-align the text content inside each panel/row, per the --f-cond 'scan' intent in the type tokens

63-arcade-operator-new-party-armed.verdict: The armed row now reads tx-1 on dark red with a thin lime focus edge and the close button is smaller, but the card still floats on a flat black void with a tiny helper line, so it is a cleaner template modal rather than a polished one.
findings: P1 Backdrop: Render the live world behind it dimmed to about 55% under --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80). Keep the card at a deliberate size, or bring it toward the 90% window spec.

P1 Confirm new party row: Use a #1e2225 fill with a 1px --danger border and a 3px --acc left bar inset by 0. Keep red to the border and a small 'clears best' label. Make the row 56px tall with a 16px gap to the next row.
P1 Helper line 'clears tonight's best · new seed': Fold it into the armed row as a right-aligned 16px tx-2 value ('clears best, new seed'), or delete it. If kept, use 16px at 4.5:1 or better.
P2 Exit demo row: Make exit demo a ghost row with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and tx-2 text. Put the dangerous confirm on the row the player has to reach deliberately.
P2 Close button: Align the x right edge to the row edge at x=1246, make it 48px, and centre it on the title's cap height.

55-arcade-run-over-scored.verdict: The card is cleaner and now has a clear title, score label, grey zero hero and a ringed prompt, but the type is still small for a couch, the lower half is crowded with rules, and the card is a lot of empty dark space with the hero still not dominant.
findings: P1 hero '0 sp' (x 634, y≈500): Make the hero a true 56px f-cond 800. Set the 'score' label to 16px tx-2. Make the stat values tx-2 at 24px so only the title and hero are bright. Leave 24px between the hero and the divider.

P1 'press any key' prompt (x 1106-1286, y≈697): Set the text to tx-1, 20px f-cond 700. Make the glyph 24px with a full #e6ff3d ring and dot. Delete the divider at y≈650, or leave 24px above and below it.
P1 labels 'kills / extractions / deaths' (y≈632) and 'score' (y≈448): Set all labels to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking in tx-2 #aaa498 or brighter. Keep a 4px gap to each value.
P2 stats row column grid (x 634, 859, 1085): Use three equal 217px columns from x 634 to 1286, or right-align the prompt with the third column. Keep 24px of padding on all sides.
P2 title block ('run over', 'ended early -50%'): Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 tx-1. Set the subline to 16px with 'ended early' in tx-2 and '-50%' in --warn. Leave 8px between them.

60-abandoned-card.verdict: The card is clean and all lower case with a clear lime main action, but it is still a small 720px modal with a weak hero, tiny stats, a loss that does not read as a loss, and an xp line that explains too much.
findings: P1 whole card (601-1318 x 246-833): Either scale it to the shared window size (90% wide, 56px header and 72px footer), or add the run-over card to the guide as a named exception with a fixed 720px width. Do not leave it undecided.
P1 hero '$1,170' / 'left behind': Set the number to 56px f-cond 800 in --danger, or add a 3px --danger top tab to the card. Set 'left behind' to 16px --tx-2 with +.04em tracking.
P1 xp line under the title (y≈362): Cut it to '+33 xp' at 16px --tx-2, plus a small --warn tag '-75%'. Move the total xp to the progress screen. Keep 24px between the title and this line.
P1 stat strip (containers / kills / accuracy / time): Set values to 32px f-cond 700 in --tx-1 and labels to 16px --tx-2. Cut the gap between hero and strip to 32px. Keep the 1px --ui-line rules.
P2 'how did that run feel +' (y≈705): Make it a tertiary text button in the footer row beside the main action, with a 2px --acc focus outline, or drop it from this card.

42-hub-pause-box.verdict: a clean, readable pause card with one lime primary action and a clear x, but the buttons are weakly graded, the secondary row is tiny, and the card does not follow the near-full-screen window rule.
findings: P1 card size and placement: either document the pause menu as a small-dialog exception, or widen the card to about 560px with 32px padding. Add a visible pad focus state to every button so it is clear which one is selected.
P1 feedback / what's new buttons: raise the label to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking, make the buttons 48px tall, and keep the 16px gap between them and the rows above.

P1 button hierarchy (settings / leaderboard / report a problem): give all secondary buttons --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Move 'report a problem' into the small row with feedback.
P1 return to character selection: give it a 48px ghost button with a 1px --danger border and --danger text, at least 20px. Keep 32px of space above it and ask the player to confirm.
P2 title bar: set the title at 32px f-cond 700, centre the x vertically with it at a 40x40 hit area, and make the accent tab a clear 2px lime line.

49-arcade-pause-box.verdict: A clean, consistent pause card with one lime primary action. The end-run gap and the card padding are tighter than before, but the card is small and generic, and it breaks the rule that windows are a big centred card.
findings: P1 whole card: Either declare the pause box an exempt compact dialog in the guide, or add identity to it: a 14px version stamp at the bottom, the run's timer or sp in the header, and a 3px lime tab on the left edge instead of the tiny 36px top tick.

P1 button stack, resume vs others: Keep resume and settings as full-width 56px buttons. Merge report, feedback and what's new into one row of three 16px ghost buttons with no border, or into the footer legend, so only two heavy buttons remain.
P2 end run: Give it a 48px-high hit area with a 1px --danger border at 40% opacity, and a full red fill on focus. Keep the 24px gap above it so it stays separated from the other buttons.
P2 header tick and divider: Make the tick 3px x 48px at full --acc, or delete it. Align the X's centre to the title's cap-height centre (they are about 2px off).
P2 focus state: Focused buttons get a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill. Resume keeps its fill and adds a 2px outer ring when it is not the focused item.

56-arcade-attract-board-scored.verdict: The card is now tidy, with a clear title, a divider and a footer row holding the 'press any key' chip, but it is a small, sparse box with an unnecessary X floating over a busy blurred scene.
findings: P1 Card shell, 558x255 at (681,412): Enlarge to about 640x320 and use a 56px hero '0 sp' (f-cond 800, tx-1) or a 3-row placeholder list inside the body. Keep the 24px padding and the divider.
P1 'no scores yet' at (713,534): Set it to f-cond 600 20px in tx-2 #aaa498. Put a 56px muted '0 sp' above it, or centre the pair vertically in the body between y=490 and y=560.

P1 'press any key' prompt (1027-1206, 600-634): Draw a 32px rounded key chip with a 1px #4a5257 border and the actual key or pad glyph inside. Set the label to 24px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Make the footer row 56px with equal 24px padding top and bottom.
P2 Close X, (1159-1207, 429-477): Remove it. If kept, make it a 40px ghost X with no fill, a tx-2 glyph, a 1px #2e3337 border, and the right edge at x=1214 (24px padding), centred on the title line.
P2 'pillagers' wordmark, (95,72): Replace it with a real logo lockup of about 160x48 at (96,54), or remove it so the screen has only the card as its focal point.

47-arcade-drop-controls-card.verdict: The controls card and the duplicate storm toasts are gone, so the screen reads as a plain in-raid HUD, but the HUD is crowded with mismatched panels, type sizes and styles, and the pad focus and hierarchy are unresolved.
findings: P1 Bottom-left vitals (24-526, 905-1068): Make all three bars 12px high with 8px gaps and the same 16px f-cond label inside the left edge. Use --ok for hp, a muted tx-2 fill for stamina, and one cool blue for armour. Align the right edges and fold the 'standing' pill into a 16px tx-2 tag above the stack.

P1 Top-right run info panel (1502-1902, 244-390): Put it in panel P (fill #16191b at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding). Set the title to 20px 700 tx-1 and 'run goals' to 16px tx-2. Use a 32px row pitch with rewards right-aligned in tx-2. Leave a 16px gap below the minimap and make the chevron 24px.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel (1577-1910, 868-1022): Use one panel style for every HUD block. Set the weapon name to 20px tx-2, the hero '60' to 56px 800 tx-1, and '/ 360' to 20px tx-2 on the same baseline. Give the panel a 16px inset and a 5% margin that matches the other corners.

P1 Top-left 'f1 controls' hint (22-135, 155-180): Draw 'f1' as a 28px key cap with tx-1 text on --ui-panel, followed by 'controls' in 16px tx-2 on a panel backing. Make the 'blackout' tag, the top toast and this hint share one pill style with 4px radius, a 3px left bar and 16px text.

P1 Top-centre score block and extract line (880-1040, 0-135): Offset the card 24px from the top. Make the timer the 56px hero and 'sp' a 20px tx-2 line. Put the extract line inside the card as a 16px teal row. Move the toast to 72px below the card, and move the arrow to a screen-edge indicator.

48-arcade-hud-move-to-start.verdict: The in-raid HUD works as a functional tutorial overlay but looks like stacked, unrelated widgets: the controls panel buries the start prompt, and six different type sizes, mixed panel styles, and washed-out low-contrast text break the guide.
findings: P0 Whole screen hierarchy: How to play panel vs the 'Shield - Move to start' prompt: Shrink the panel to a 4-row essentials list or collapse it to a dismissible strip. Promote the start prompt to a 32px tx-1 centred line with a key cap ('WASD  Move to start'). Make the panel 70% opacity so the world and the prompt read first.

P1 Top-centre score block (Score / 0 SP / 9:46 / Extract 140m): Sit the block 24px below the top edge, SP at 56px f-cond 800 tx-1, timer 20px tx-1, extract line 16px --extract on a 40px --ui-panel 90% chip. Drop the 'Score' label or move it to 16px tx-2.

P1 Bottom-left status stack (Standing, Armour 60, Stamina, HP 100): One bar component: 12px high, 320px wide, 8px gap, 16px tx-1 label left-aligned above or inside each bar. HP gets the only heavy treatment (24px number). Drop the 'Standing' tab or make it a 16px chip. Move the stack to the 5% margin.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel ('B / I backpack', Burst Carbine 24 / 144, 4 items $390): Use a 1px --ui-line-hi bordered panel with 24px padding, inset 5% from the edges. Ammo is the hero at 56px, weapon name 20px tx-2. Make the hint a cap plus a word ('B  Backpack'). Replace '$390' with 'Credits 390' or remove it.

P1 Run Info / Run goals panel (right, under the minimap): Merge to one 16px tx-2 label, 'Run goals'. Rows at 16px tx-1 with right-aligned SP values in tx-2, 8px gaps, 16px padding, 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill. Leave a 16px gap below the minimap.

53-arcade-extracted-bonus-initials.verdict: This is still a cluttered in-raid HUD, not the extracted/bonus/initials end card the filename promises, and the same extract message appears four times at four different sizes.
findings: P0 Whole screen vs. filename (extracted / bonus / initials): Capture the end state: hide the HUD, show a 720px centred card on rgba(6,7,8,.80), 32px --extract title, one 56px hero SP number, a 4-stat row, initials tiles, and one 56px --acc primary button.

P0 Extract messaging: centre banner card, 'hold [x] to extract' at ~48px, bottom 'extract in progress! b 28s left', left toast 'extract in progress!': Keep one centre prompt only. Delete the banner card, the toast and the bottom line. Show one 56px f-cond 800 --extract countdown ('28 s') with a 16px 'hold [x]' label under it. Remove the stray 'b'.

P1 Top-centre cluster: 'score / 0 sp / 9:51 / extraction 0m / arrow': One 56px hero (the extract timer while extracting, otherwise SP), with a 16px tx-2 'score' label. Fold the extraction distance and arrow into one element inside the panel. Give it 24px padding and a 5% top margin.

P1 Run info panel (right, ~1500-1900 x 245-390): Panel P: --ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 24px padding. One 20px tx-1 title, delete the duplicate 'run goals' line. Rows at 16px with 8px gaps, values right-aligned in tx-2. 16px gap below the minimap.

P1 Left toast stack (5 toasts, 20-430 x 600-775): Cap at 3 toasts, 40px high, 8px gap, 5% left margin. Remove the duplicates and the tip text. Use the danger colour only on the glyph, with tx-1 for the text.

54-arcade-initials-redrop.verdict: The HUD works as an in-raid overlay, but the same extraction event appears four times, the top-centre block is cramped and overlaps, and type sizes, tags and panel styles ignore the guide.
findings: P0 Extraction messaging (centre banner, top toast, left feed, bottom line): Keep one: a 56px hero countdown in --extract at top-centre ('25 s'), plus a 40px toast at most. Delete the left-feed copy, the bottom line and the 'Extraction 0m' label. Make the 25 s the only big number.

P0 Top-centre block: Score / 0 SP / 9:48 / Extraction 0m / arrow / '?' / toast / 'Warden' label: Move the toast to its own slot at y≈96 with 40px height and no overlap. Push the block in from the top by at least 24px. Drop the '?' and the arrow, or put them in the world. Raise the 'Score' label to 16px.

P1 Bottom-centre text: 'Extract in progress! C 25S left', '19 hostiles closing in': Write '25 s'. Remove the 'C'. Put the line on a 40px toast with a 4px danger bar, or drop it. Keep 16px of clear space above the hotbar tag.

P1 Bottom-left feed (Stronghold, Golden enemy, Spotted, Extract): Show at most 3 toasts, each 40px high with a 4px left bar. Use tx-1 text at 16px minimum and a --scrim fill. Remove info toasts that repeat the map state. Hide the grey ones after 3 s.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel: Make the ammo 56px f-cond 800 and the weapon name 20px tx-2. Change the key hint to a cap plus a word ('B  Backpack') at 16px in a footer. Replace '$390' with 'SP 390' or remove it. Shrink the panel to fit its content, with 24px padding.

64-arcade-board-seeded-night.verdict: the card is still a small, quiet dialog with a tiny 'seeded night' line, a bare 'no scores yet', a dim prompt and a blurred, busy backdrop, so nothing here reads as AAA polish.
findings: P1 'seeded night · zbxx' (x713-837, y496): Show only 'seeded night' at 16px f-cond 600, +.04em, in tx-2 #aaa498, 8px under the title. Drop the seed code.

P1 'no scores yet' (x713-820, y545): Draw 5 ghost rows at 40px pitch (rank, name, sp) in --ui-line at 40% opacity under the title block. Keep 'no scores yet' in tx-1 20px above them. No explanatory sentence.

P1 'press any key' prompt (x1027-1206, y612-645): Set the text to 20px f-cond 600 tx-1. Replace the dot with a 24px key chip showing the live key or pad glyph. Put the right edge on the 24px padding line at x1214. Use --ui-line-hi #4a5257 for the divider at y582.

P1 card and scrim (x681-1239, y400-680): Raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) and add 2px blur-free darkening. Either widen the card to about 720px with a 24px padding grid, or make it a 90% window with a 56px header and 72px footer.
P2 close x (x1159-1207, y417-465): Make the glyph 20px tx-1 in a 40px box centred on y443, with the right edge at x1214. Draw a 2px --acc border when focused.

70-settings-sec-controls.verdict: The detail pane is now flat, but the settings card still has the same weaknesses as before: a narrow 960px column floating in a 1870px card, steppers stranded mid-row, tiny low-contrast tabs, and a list that is clipped mid-row.
findings: P1 whole card: 960px column centred in a 1870px card, with about 450px of empty void on each side: Widen the list column to about 1400px, or add a 280px left rail for the tabs (the raid, audio, controls...) and give the rows the rest. Left-align the title with the column.

P1 value column: arrows at x≈923 and x≈1175, values at x≈1049: Right-align the stepper to a column ending 24px inside the row. Use 20px tx-1 values and 24px tx-2 arrows, with the arrows turning lime only on the focused row. Give action rows ('change keys') a 1px --ui-line-hi pill or button outline so they read as buttons.

P1 tab strip (the raid ... accessibility) and 'send play data' at the top right: Use 20px tabs with 32px gaps, a 3px lime underline plus tx-1 on the active tab, and tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better for the rest. Move 'send play data' into the list as a row or into the footer. Add lb/rb glyphs at the strip ends.

P2 bottom of the list, 'stick deadzone' row (y≈825): Snap the viewport to whole rows (for example 10 × 56px = 560px), or add a 24px gradient mask at the bottom. Make the scrollbar 6px in --ui-line-hi and brighter on focus.

P2 detail pane (keys / rebind...), y≈860-978: Put a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill back at 24px padding, with an 8px gap above the pane. Use a 20px tx-1 title and a 16px tx-2 body trimmed to one short clause, e.g. 'rebind any action; conflicts swap'.

76-haul-reveal-mid.verdict: the haul reveal reads clean at a glance but contradicts its own success check and is missing half the component polish the style guide requires.
findings: P0 objective line vs haul number: gate the checkmark on the actual haul total (haul >= 1200) or drop the objective line when it was not met; never show a check next to a number that contradicts it.
P1 xp line under the title, 'extracted': relabel to 'sp' if this is the score track, or get an explicit ruling from the owner before shipping a new 'xp' currency distinct from $ and sp.

P1 item grid, rows under the recovered-weapons lines: collapse the grid to only the slots that hold items (pack them left-to-right, no empty cells), or if empty slots are intentional capacity indicators, dim them further and add a consistent dashed outline so they read as 'empty' and not 'missing render'.
P1 item icon slots: add the 3px rarity-color bottom or left bar from the token set to every filled slot so the grid matches the Diablo-style rarity read the guide specifies.

P2 'first out . heavy haul . untouched . ghost' row: render each as a small pill/tag (1px --ui-line-hi border, --rad corners, --fs-label text) so they read as discrete earned badges, not a sentence fragment.

75-settings-pad-rebind-waiting.verdict: the waiting chip now reads cleanly as the one lime thing (image 2 calms the banner to a raised fill with a thin lime tab), but the screen is still a flat wall of same-weight 16px text with a left-heavy offset layout, a faded half-row at the bottom, and a footer that strands 'esc close' in the corner.
findings: P1 banner 'press a button for sprint · esc cancels': keep the image 2 treatment (--ui-raised fill) with a 3px --acc tab, set text to 20px tx-1, and cut it to 'press a button for sprint'. Move 'esc cancels' to the footer legend at 16px tx-2, and show 'b cancel' on pad.

P1 list rows and chips (all categories): category labels 16px tx-2 uppercase-free with +.04em tracking, no bold. Action names 20px tx-1 weight 600. Idle chips use --ui-raised fill and a --ui-line border. Keep --acc only on the waiting chip.

P1 bottom of list, 'world' row (ping, pause): snap the scroll so the focused row is fully visible, or add a 24px gradient mask to --ui-panel. Make the scrollbar 6px --ui-line-hi, with the thumb in tx-2.

P2 left edge alignment: pick one left edge: align the banner and list to x=49 with the title, or centre a 1440px column and align the title to it. Align category labels and action names to the same inset.

P2 footer 'reset to defaults' and 'esc close': make one 72px footer row: reset on the left, and on the right a legend 'b close · y reset' at 16px tx-2 with pad glyphs. Both items are vertically centred on the same line.

72-settings-sec-display.verdict: the settings card is clean, consistent and all lower case, but the detail pane is a huge empty box, the stepper columns float mid-row, and the list is cut off at the bottom, so it still reads as a template options screen.
findings: P1 right detail pane (x=1088-1870, y=116-994): Narrow the pane to about 420px and give the freed width to the list. Or keep it full height and add a 56px f-cond 800 hero readout of the current value ('full') in --acc under the 32px title. Put the description 24px below the title at 20px f-body tx-1 and top-align it.

P1 stepper columns (chevrons x≈731 and x≈982, value x≈857, row x=338-1046): Right-align the cluster to the row edge: chevrons at x≈1000 and x≈1030 with a 160px value cell centred between them. Or shrink the list column to about 560px. Make the chevrons 20px, with tx-2 when idle and --acc when the row is focused.

P1 list bottom (rows 'crosshair' and 'crosshair colour', y≈900-994): End the viewport on a multiple of the 56px row height (for example y=952), 16px above the footer. Limit the fade to the last 24px. Make the thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, inset 8px from the border, with a visible track.

P1 left rail (x=50-313) idle items and 'send play data' (y=555): Set idle items to 20px f-cond 600 tx-2 and the selected item to tx-1 on --ui-raised. Add a 1px --ui-line divider and 24px of space above 'send play data', and mark it as a utility link in 16px tx-2.

P2 focused row 'render resolution' (x=338-1046, y=117-171) and the detail pane top edge (y=116): Inset the list 8px from the top, or add a 1px --ui-line gap. Make the pane's top tab 36px wide, not full-width, so only the focused row carries the strong lime.

74-settings-change-pad-buttons.verdict: The layout switcher and controller diagram give the screen a real hero and a purpose, but the pad drawing is crude with overlapping labels, the list is cramped and cut off, and the small text is too dim for a couch.
findings: P0 controller diagram, d-pad cluster and face buttons: Redraw the d-pad as a 96px cross with every label inside its arm (16px, centred). Make face buttons 40px circles on a 64px diamond. Keep stick labels in one line style, 20px. Give lb/lt/rb/rt matching 8px gaps. Draw the pad outline at about 60% line brightness (--ui-line-hi) so the labels read above it.

P1 bottom-right legend table (lt/rt/lb/rb/view/...): Drop the table or the left list's duplicate role. If the table stays, raise the button names to tx-1 at 16px 600, set the action at 20px, and give the rows a 1px --ui-line divider. Align the column starts to the diagram's centre. Better: put the action text next to each diagram label as callouts and delete the table.

P1 layout selector (top-left): Make the box 48px high with arrows centred vertically (align to the 20px text centre). Render '1/6' in tx-2 and the preset name in tx-1 at 20px 700. Give the focused state a 2px lime border. Raise the label to 16px tx-2 at the 4.5:1 floor.

P2 header and divider rows: Centre the diagram in the pane (centre x of about 1232 against its current 1232? Measure it: the pad is at x 900-1565, so its centre is 1232, but the pane centre is 1232, which is fine). The real fix is to scale the diagram up 15% to fill the pane, and make the 24px gaps between rule, selector and content equal.

01-title-mode-menu.verdict: the menu is a clean, readable column with a clear lime primary action, but the orange gradient logo breaks the lime accent system and the lower half is crowded, tiny and unbalanced; the only change from the old shot is the background crowd of characters moving.
findings: P1 title logo 'pillagers': Make the wordmark flat --tx-1 or --acc in f-cond 800 at 56px+ with no gradient and no shadow. Keep gold only as a 3px rarity bar. If the gradient art stays, treat it as art and drop the lime fill from the button below so the two never sit side by side.

P1 mode button stack (1 player, 2 player co-op, 2 player arcade demo, 1 player arcade demo): Group by intent: 1 player (primary, 56px tall), 2 player co-op as the second row, and move the two arcade demos into a smaller 'demo' row or into the settings card. Raise the idle border to --ui-line-hi #4a5257 and give the focus row a 4px lime left bar so it reads at couch distance.

P1 saves block (saves label, 'pillager new' row, name field, change name, create a new save): Raise the save row to 56px with a filled --ui-raised and a 3px lime left bar, and set the name in tx-1 at 20px. Put the three controls on one 40px-high row with one shared outline style, giving 'change name' and 'create a new save' the same fill and the same 8px gap. Give the input a 'name' placeholder in tx-2 at 16px.

P2 tagline 'ascend. pillage. extract.': Set it in f-cond 600 at 20px in --tx-2 (#aaa498) with 0.08em tracking, and put it 16px under the logo with 32px before the first button. Check it is 4.5:1 or better against the dimmed background.

44-title-from-character-select.verdict: The title screen has a clear hierarchy, with a gold logo and a lime primary button, but it is crowded, a toast overlaps the key legend, and the logo's gold and the lime accent clash.
